entries.appliesTo: persons making AI-created telephone campaign communications using the voice of a public figure

dutySources.disclosure-ui: R.S. 18:1463.1(D) — 'without providing a clear and understandable disclosure at the beginning of the call that it was created using artificial intelligence'

sources.disclosure: R.S. 18:1463.1(D) — 'No person shall make or cause to be made any telephone call or automated call provided for in this Section which is created using artificial intelligence, using the voice of a public figure, including an elected official or limited public figure, without providing a clear and understandable disclosure at the beginning of the call that it was created using artificial intelligence.'
sources.scope: R.S. 18:1463.1 heading and (D) — 'Telephone campaign communications; disclosure' / 'any telephone call or automated call provided for in this Section'
sources.penaltyMax: R.S. 18:1463.1(G) — 'Upon a second or subsequent violation, the penalty shall be a civil fine not to exceed five thousand dollars.'
sources.penaltyUnit: R.S. 18:1463.1(G) — 'Whoever violates any provision of this Section may be punished by a civil fine not to exceed two thousand five hundred dollars.'
sources.enforcer: R.S. 18:1463.1(H) — 'The Board of Ethics shall administer and enforce the provisions of this Section.'

flags: tiered civil fine: first violation capped at $2,500, second or subsequent violation capped at $5,000 (§1463.1(G)); penaltyMax codes the higher tier

disclosure duty is scoped to calls 'using the voice of a public figure, including an elected official or limited public figure' (§1463.1(D)) — narrower than all AI-created calls; no param exists for this voice-of-public-figure trigger

liability exemption in §1463.1(F) for interactive computer services (47 U.S.C. 230), ISPs/cloud/cybersecurity/information-service/telecommunications-service providers, and radio/TV broadcasters 'as a result of content provided by another person'
'Artificial intelligence' defined by cross-reference: §1463.1(E)(1) — 'shall have the same meaning as provided in R.S. 14:73.14' (not imported per rule 4)
